newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline little changed, seeking U.S. directio.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline little changed, seeking U.S. directio.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were little changed on Tuesday. Traders said the market was looking to U.S. stocks data and NYMEX futures for fresh direction after the long weekend holiday.
Eurograde barges valued around $194 a tonne fob ARA for May 1-15 liftings while all May liftings talked $194/$195. Regular barges traded at $184 a tonne fob ARA.
No cargo deals were heard done but prices were notionally valued around $200 cif for premium unleaded.

Weaker U.S. unleaded futures have limited arbitrage options and left dealers unconvinced that prices can hold current levels amid evidence that U.S. demand is running only very slightly above last year's levels.
However, rich NWE margins may prompt NWE refiners into boosting output, but traders said much would hinge on the arbitrage.
Around 200,000 to 300,000 tonnes was sold to the U.S. in the second half of April, down from 800,000 tonnes in April 1996.
